note: Shoshone NF campground on the east shore of Beartooth Lake, on the Beartooth Highway (US-212) about 8 mi past the Chief Joseph Scenic Highway junction; sites sit in lodgepole forest set back from the shore, with a boat ramp and trailhead in the campground. Bear boxes provided. --Claude
summary: FS page: 21 sites, 32-ft max spur, $25 cash/check, 16-day limit, vault toilets + potable water, late June - early/mid Sept; no recreation.gov listing -> FCFS confirmed. Pin ~630 m off on the rock slope S of US-212 -> move. Recommend lakeview -> not waterfront (sites 80-150 m back in continuous conifer canopy). Phone empty -> (307) 527-6921.
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend lakeview -> not waterfront, default down): on Esri imagery the campground spurs sit in continuous lodgepole canopy on the ridge between Beartooth Lake and a meadow, ~80-150 m from the shore with dense forest and an open grass bench between; the nearest vehicles in spurs (about 44.9439,-109.5910, by the boat-ramp road) are still ~80 m back behind trees. No official campsite photos exist (the FS page has none; no recreation.gov listing). The stored waterfront_evidence was read at the stored pin (on the rock slope south of the highway, not the campground) and leans on Campendium reviews ('no sites directly lakefront, short walk down to lake') - an aggregator. The FS's 'located along the shores of Beartooth Lake' is campground-level prose. Nothing confirms a lake view from an RV site, so the view value goes down per the default-down rule.

PIN MOVE (~630 m): stored 44.94170,-109.59520 is on a rocky slope south of US-212, across the highway from the campground. The FS page gives 44.94468,-109.5885, which sits in the spur area on imagery. Suggested pin 44.9447,-109.5885.
Phone: empty -> (307) 527-6921 (FS page Contact: Clarks Fork, Greybull, and Wapiti Ranger Districts).

Note: dropped the site count, spur length, water/toilets/hookups (fields) and the unsourced 'most sites suit RVs 25 ft and under, a couple in the first loop take larger rigs' (not on the FS page); max spur 32 ft fits a 23-ft rig. Stored inclusion_evidence ('larger-RV sites in first loop') carries the same unsourced claim - suggested: 'Shoshone NF Beartooth Lake page: 21-site drive-in campground, 32-ft max spur, $25, potable water -> real RV campground'.
